objective: Improve performance against fixed external opponents, with independent matched validation and both competition clocks.
status: v08 qualified and promoted; field and clock artifacts audited
data_policy: No opponent evaluations/PVs, foreign engine code, pretrained networks, opening books or tablebases used by the candidate. Opponent moves and outcomes only.
caveats: Sampled random legal openings can give either colour a large advantage; paired versions and colour reversals control comparisons. These are not standard-position tournament win rates.
Stockfish Skill 3/5 are reduced UCI settings, not Lichess levels.
The practical TT mode has repetition/clock/mate guards but is a heuristic, not a general GHI correctness proof.
Evaluation variants intentionally differ from the Python reference; rules and colour-symmetry checks are separate.
